title: Religious Bias Landscape in Language and Text-to-Image Models: Analysis, Detection, and Debiasing Strategies
reasoning: The paper is centered on evaluating and benchmarking religious bias in models. It specifically analyzes how different religions (such as Islam, Christianity, Hinduism, Judaism, and Buddhism) are represented and whether they are associated with negative stereotypes like violence or terrorism, which constitutes a direct evaluation of religion and related ethical/moral considerations.
